G4012.as:
περί, prep. c. gen., acc. (in cl. also c. dat.; cf. M, Pr., 105f.),
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides).
I. C. gen.,
1. of place, about (poët.).
2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: , , , , , al. mult.; τὰ περί, c. gen., the things concerning one, one's state or case: , , , al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, , al.; in the sense on account of (, , al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105).
II. C. acc.,
1. of place, about, around: , , , , al.; οἱ περί, c. acc. pers., of one's associates, friends, etc., , , , ; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, ; metaph., about, as to, concerning: , , ; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, ; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, .
2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: , , , , , , .
III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).

† περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό (< περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, De 18:10, Jos 5:4, IV Mac 1:29*), [in LXX: Pr 21:18 (כֹּפֶר)*;]
1. a victim, expiation (Pr 21:18).
2. refuse, rubbish: pl., (v. ICC, in l.).†

G4067.as:
**† περί-ψημα, -τος, τό (< περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: To 5:18*;]
that which is wiped off, offscouring: metaph. (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, q.v.), (and so prob., To 5:18, as EV; but v. Thayer, s.v., for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, s.v. κάθαρμα; Lft., Notes, 200 f., and on Ign., Eph., 8).†

G4018.as:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό (< περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ, כְּסוּת and cognate forms;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
(a) a mantle (Ps 101 (102):27, Is 59:17, al.): (LXX);
(b) a veil: (but v. ICC, in l.).†

G4068.as:
*† περπερεύομαι (< περπερος, vainglorious),
to boast or vaunt oneself: (elsewh. only in Antonin.; v. Abbott, Essays, 87).†

G4056.tb: to a greater degree; especially, frequently, extremely more, more abundantly, more earnestly, more vehemently, exceedingly, extremely

G4006.as:
† πεποίθησις, -εως, ἡ (< πείθω), [in LXX: IV Ki 18:19 (בִּטָּחוֹן)*;]
confidence: , ; seq. εἰς, ; ἐν, (the word is condemned by the Atticists, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 355).†

G4070.as:
*† πέρυσι, adv. (< πέρας),
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. v. Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), .†

G4080.as:
πηλίκος, -η, -ον, [in LXX: Za 2:2 (6) (כַּמָּה), IV Mac 15:22*;]
interrog., how large, how great? (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (v. Bl., § 51, 4), ; of personal greatness, .†

G4047.as:
† περι-ποίησις, -εως, ἡ (< περιποιέω), [in LXX: II Ch 4:13 (12) (מִחְיָה), Ma 3:17 (סְגֻלָּה), Hg 2:10 (9)*;]
1. preservation: (II Ch 4:13).
2. acquisition, obtaining: , (and so perh. , v. infr.).
3. a possession: (but v. supr., and cf. ICC, in l.), (LXX).†

G4030.as:
† περι-κεφαλαία, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע;]
a helmet: fig., ; c. gen. explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, (cf. Is 59:17).†

G4086.as:
* πιθανολογία, -ας, ἡ (< πιθανός, persuasive, plausible), in cl. (Plat),
the use of probable arguments, as opp. to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, persuasive speech: (v. ICC, in l.).†

G4087.as:
πικραίνω (< πικρός), [in LXX for מרר, קצף, etc.;]
to make bitter: ; pass., ; metaph., to embitter (LXX): pass., seq. πρός, .†

G4035.as:
περι-λείπομαι, depon. mid. and pass., [in LXX: II Ch 34:21 A (שׁאר ni.), II Mac 1:31 8:14, IV Mac 12:6 13:18*;]
to be left remaining, remain over, survive: , .†

G4020.as:
** περι-εργάζομαι, [in LXX: Wi 8:5 א1, Si 3:23*;]
1. to waste one's labour about a thing.
2. to be a busybody: (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†

G4044.as:
*† περι-πείρω,
to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaph., ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, .†

G4041.as:
† περιούσιος, -ον (< περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: Ex 19:5 23:22, De 7:6 14:2 26:18 (סְגֻלָּה, עַם ם׳)*;]
one's own, of one's own possession: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, Ex 19:5 23:22, De 7:6 14:2 26:18), .†

G4065.as:
** περι-φρονέω, -ῶ, [in LXX: IV Mac 6:9 14:1*;]
1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.).
2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; IV Mac 6:9 14:1): .†

G4078.as:
πήγνυμι, [in LXX chiefly for נטה, also for תּקע, etc.;]
to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch: (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†

G4089.as:
πικρός, -ά, -όν (poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for מַר;]
1. sharp, pointed.
2. sharp to the senses; of taste, bitter: opp. to γλυκύ, ; metaph., harsh, bitter: .

G4025.as:
**† περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ (< περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Ps 31 (32):9*;]
a putting around, putting on: .†

G4010.as:
Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ (so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain),
Pergamum, a city of Mysia: .†

G4072.as:
πέτομαι, [in LXX chiefly for עוּף;]
to fly: (Rec. πετάομαι, q.v.).†
